categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on small molecule and nucleic acid new drug discovery and optimization, leveraging four core technology platforms: DNA-encoded library (DEL) technology, fragment-based and structure-based drug design (FBDD/SBDD), oligonucleotide new drug development (STO), and targeted protein degradation (TPD). It provides new drug R&D services, in-progress project equity transfers, and advances proprietary drug candidates toward clinical trials and eventual market launch.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include DEL for ultra-large compound library design, synthesis, and screening; FBDD/SBDD for fragment and structure-based drug design; STO platform for oligonucleotide synthesis, modification, and delivery system development; and TPD platform focusing on novel E3 ligase ligand discovery and PROTAC development. The company integrates AI and machine learning to enhance drug discovery and optimization processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, chemical companies, foundations, and research institutions. The company serves markets across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, providing early-stage drug discovery services and proprietary drug candidates for unmet clinical needs worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span China (headquartered in Chengdu), the United States, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and other international locations. The company has subsidiaries and business activities in major biopharmaceutical hubs including North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on early-stage drug discovery, compound library synthesis, screening services, and preclinical drug candidate development rather than manufacturing or downstream commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous enhancement of DEL technology and expansion of compound library diversity, integration of DEL with FBDD/SBDD platforms, development of nucleic acid drug platforms and delivery systems, and advancement of protein degradation technologies. The company emphasizes AI-driven drug discovery, high-throughput synthesis and testing, and progressing proprietary drug candidates through clinical phases.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through fee-for-service (FFS) contracts, full-time equivalent (FTE) service agreements, intellectual property licensing and transfer fees, milestone payments from drug development progress, and equity transfers of in-progress drug projects. The company also earns income from government grants and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading innovator in DEL technology globally and uniquely combines DEL with FBDD/SBDD, STO, and TPD platforms, differentiating it from traditional CROs and biotech firms. It competes with international pharmaceutical companies and specialized drug discovery service providers, maintaining strong partnerships with top global pharma companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 371 million, a 12.64% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 61.16% to about RMB 40.7 million. Operating cash flow grew significantly by 137.42%. The company maintains a robust R&D investment at 21.44% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers the world's largest known DNA-encoded small molecule compound library with over 1.2 trillion diverse and drug-like molecules, enabling rapid and cost-effective discovery of novel lead compounds. Its integrated technology platforms and AI capabilities accelerate drug discovery and optimization, providing high-quality, patentable molecules and flexible collaboration models that reduce client risk and enhance innovation efficiency.
